diagnostic.interpretation: Single instrumented baseline. Scopes include required work, QPC/counter overhead and scheduling, not exclusiveCPU/removable bound or A/B result. Capture includes entire scene copying; actor scope includes placement, clipping, priority/terrain checks, color and output as well as bitplane decoding.

limitations: This is a scoped value/complexity decision, not a minimum positive-gain acceptance rule or proof of regression. Net positive and neutral remain acceptable. Here both profiles lack demonstrated benefit and the candidate adds about20KiB of persistent derived cache plus new API/invalidation ownership.

Existing Zelda background decoding/terrain caching is baseline, not a newly measured optimization. The candidate replaces per-byte logical8KiB capture and repeated actor/subroom bitplane extraction with an owned uncolored plan, retaining palettes/placement/priority/order at consumers.

The profiling outer wall scopes include required copying/clipping/priority/color/output and measurement/preemption; they are neither exclusive CPU costs nor recoverable bounds. Capture5.9522ms/374calls and actor69.471ms/47872roomvisits are .2073% and2.4193% of observed wall, respectively.

Both controls reproduce all present runtime COFF sections of the actual selected objects. Final ordered manifests differ only in cyc_render and zelda_world objects; remaining121 objects stay identical, including accepted native job/oracle and canvas. No new hook or regeneration is required for this additive prototype.

Fixture covers five boards, all512tiles, all65536 row-plane combinations, actualbankchanges, truncated/moduloCHR RAM and retained owned-image restore. Initial fixture target omitted render/video sources and failed linking; corrected target passed. This is not a game failure.

Fit426x240/15rooms and Atlas4096x1472/128rooms each have three alternating600frame matched SDL pairs after excluded warmups on this PC. Dummy audio is emulated/mixed, not real-device latency testing. Each profile matches40picture/frame/hardware/RAM/PCM/MOD hashes; all negative samples and telemetry retained.

Timed legs load their own currentbuild state and run successfully, but exact post-restore continuation against uninterrupted execution and retained portal/inventory CHR behavior are not qualified. The routes have empty portal scene records. The prepared boundary driver was intentionally NOT run after no demonstrated benefit; no portal gameplay claim.

Other HD/voxel/nametable/OAM consumers, general revision ownership and different algorithms remain unmeasured residuals. One scoped prototype does not exhaust NES12 architecture. No new runtime source selected, no merge/release. Final supported CLI/five-title builds and combined owner checks remain pending.
